```{r results='asis'}
media <- yaml::read_yaml("data/media.yml", eval.expr = FALSE)
html_text <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub('"', "&quot;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
render_media <- function(section) {
  items <- Filter(function(x) identical(x$section, section), media)
  is_list <- section %in% c("writing", "printed_news")
  if (is_list) cat('<ul>\n')
  for (item in items) {
    stopifnot(grepl("^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$", item$id))
    cat(if (is_list) '<li id="' else '<div id="', item$id, '">\n', sep = "")
    title <- html_text(item$title)
    if (!is.null(item$url)) {
      stopifnot(grepl("^https://", item$url))
      title <- paste0('<a href="', html_text(item$url), '">', title, '</a>')
    }
    if (is_list) {
      cat('<p>', title, '</p>\n', sep = "")
    } else {
      cat('<h3>', title, '</h3>\n', sep = "")
    }
    if (!is.null(item$outlet)) cat('<p><em>', html_text(item$outlet), '</em></p>\n', sep = "")
    if (!is.null(item$date)) cat('<p>', html_text(item$date), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    if (!is.null(item$description)) cat('<p>', html_text(item$description), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    if (!is.null(item$embed)) {
      provider <- item$embed$provider
      src <- item$embed$src
      patterns <- c(youtube = '^https://www[.]youtube[.]com/embed/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$',
                    apple_podcasts = '^https://embed[.]podcasts[.]apple[.]com/',
                    libsyn = '^https://html5-player[.]libsyn[.]com/embed/')
      stopifnot(provider %in% names(patterns), grepl(patterns[[provider]], src))
      src <- html_text(src)
      label <- html_text(item$title)
      if (provider == "youtube") {
        cat('<div class="video-container"><iframe src="', src, '" title="', label,
            '" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe></div>\n', sep = "")
      } else if (provider == "apple_podcasts") {
        cat('<div style="margin-top: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"><iframe title="', label,
            '" allow="autoplay *; encrypted-media *; fullscreen *" frameborder="0" height="175" style="width:100%;max-width:660px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:12px;" sandbox="allow-forms allow-popups allow-same-origin allow-scripts allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation" src="', src, '"></iframe></div>\n', sep = "")
      } else if (provider == "libsyn") {
        cat('<div style="margin-top: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"><iframe title="', label,
            '" style="border:none" src="', src, '" height="90" width="100%" scrolling="no"></iframe></div>\n', sep = "")
      }
    }
    cat(if (is_list) '</li>\n\n' else '</div>\n\n')
  }
  if (is_list) cat('</ul>\n')
}
```

## Writing & Commentary
```{r results='asis'}
render_media("writing")
```

### Printed news

